You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
EPISODE 26 of 50 (script duration 120.9 s)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
E1: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
E2: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
...
E16: When hired thugs attack Juliana's medicinal garden, Alexander unleashes his combat training to effortlessly overpower them, extracting a shocking confession that unmasks Gerald Harrington as the mastermind.
E17: In the aftermath of the brutal attack, Alexander repairs Juliana's devastated garden and swears to protect her with his life, drawing them into a tender, intimate embrace by the hearth.
E18: When their cottage is deliberately set ablaze in the dead of night, Alexander risks his life to rescue Juliana and her mother's cherished ledger from the inferno, vowing relentless vengeance against those responsible.
E19: Standing before the smoldering ash of their home, Juliana and Alexander receive shelter and food from grateful villagers before Alexander meets in secret with a loyal spy, learning that his usurping enemies have imprisoned his mother and claimed his ducal seat.
E20: Inside the opulent Ashbury estate, the treacherous Rupert and Catherine plot to seize the ducal title as the Dowager Duchess slowly withers, while in an icy barn, Juliana defiantly prepares remedies to save the fever-stricken villagers.
E21: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.
E22: Disguised as a common scullery maid, Lady Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor alongside Prudence and slips into the forbidden West Wing, where she discovers the dying Dowager Duchess suffering from an unnatural, poisoned affliction.
E23: After examining the dying Dowager Duchess's blackened fingernails and consulting her late mother's remedy journal, Lady Juliana discovers the Duchess is being poisoned with arsenic—only for someone to arrive at the bedroom door just as she begins concocting the antidote.
E24: When an arrogant noblewoman catches Juliana in the poisoned Dowager Duchess's chambers, she strikes Juliana with a riding crop and sentences her to scrub the hearth, unaware that Juliana has secretly hidden the antidote and remedy journal to finish the Duchess's cure.
E25: Deep in the misty forest, Alexander confronts an injured Juliana and uncovers the wound inflicted by Lady Catherine, reacting with fury and protective concern upon learning that someone is systematically poisoning the Dowager Duchess with arsenic.
Direct lead-in to E26: Following her encounter with Alexander in the forest where she vowed to protect the Duchess, Juliana sneaks into the bedchamber at Ashburg Manor to deliver the remaining antidote before Rupert and Catherine's poison takes full hold.

THIS EPISODE'S LOGLINE: While secretly administering a charcoal antidote to the poisoned Dowager Duchess in the dead of night, Juliana is stunned when the Duchess suddenly recognizes a distinctive family ring on her hand and fiercely demands the truth about her identity.

TIMED SCRIPT. Each line is [ID start-end seconds]. SCREEN/ACTION lines describe what is visible.
[L001 0.0-5.8] SCREEN: Wide shot framed through heavy bed curtains in a dark, candlelit bedchamber. Juliana in her maid's apron sits vigilantly beside the canopied bed where the frail Dowager Duchess lies.
[L002 0.0-5.5] ACTION: Juliana glances nervously back toward the door, ensuring no guards are near, before turning her full attention back to the ailing Duchess.
[L003 5.8-10.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's hands unscrewing the glass dropper from a small amber medicine bottle filled with dark medicinal liquid.
[L004 6.5-9.0] SFX: Tense, atmospheric orchestral score builds softly in the background.
[L005 10.5-14.2] SCREEN: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess resting against pale pillows as her heavy eyelids slowly open, her gaze weak and disoriented.
[L006 11.0-14.0] ACTION: The Dowager Duchess blinks against the dim lamplight, turning her head toward Juliana.
[L007 14.2-20.5] SCREEN: Low-angle medium two-shot looking past Juliana's silhouette down to the Duchess in bed.
[L008 14.2-20.2] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Weak, Raspy): "Who are you? Speak to me. I have not seen your face before."
[L009 20.5-25.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana leaning over the bed, holding the dropper bottle carefully toward the Duchess's mouth, her expression urgent yet tender.
[L010 20.6-25.4] JULIANA (Urgent, Reassuring): "Please, Your Grace. Drink the last of this antidote. Drink it slowly."
[L011 25.8-28.5] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of the Duchess taking drops of the dark liquid from the glass bottle onto her lips.
[L012 25.8-28.4] ACTION: The Duchess swallows the remedy with difficulty as Juliana carefully tilts the amber bottle.
[L013 28.5-30.8] SCREEN: Medium two-shot as Juliana withdraws the medicine bottle, standing beside the bedside lamp.
[L014 30.8-35.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess observing Juliana with faint recognition through her exhaustion.
[L015 30.8-35.5] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Faint, Discerning): "You... you are no common servant. You took Catherine's whip for me the other day."
[L016 35.8-40.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes reflecting quiet resolve and pain.
[L017 36.0-39.8] JULIANA (Humble, Sincere): "I did what I had to. It does not change my duty."
[L018 40.2-43.2] SCREEN: Medium two-shot as Juliana leans closer to tuck the blankets securely over the Duchess.
[L019 40.3-43.0] JULIANA (Gentle, Calming): "Rest now, Your Grace. You are safe tonight."
[L020 43.2-47.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking around the shadowy room, her voice dropping to a tense whisper.
[L021 43.5-47.0] JULIANA (Hushed, Tense Whisper): "If the guards hear us, we are both dead."
[L022 47.5-50.8] SCREEN: Static shot of the heavy carved double doors to the bedchamber, left slightly ajar with a sliver of hallway candlelight gleaming through the gap.
[L023 50.8-55.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying back, processing Juliana's warning as dark realization settles into her face.
[L024 52.5-55.5] ACTION: The Duchess clutches the blanket against her chest, her breathing quickening with dismay.
[L025 55.8-62.5] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Duchess looking upward toward Juliana, her voice trembling with tragic certainty.
[L026 56.0-62.0] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Heartbroken): "Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?"
[L027 62.5-67.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana leaning over the edge of the mattress, nodding earnestly to soothe her fears.
[L028 62.6-66.7] JULIANA (Reassuring, Steadfast): "Yes. But the charcoal is fighting the poison. You are safe now."
[L029 67.0-71.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the small amber dropper bottle sitting atop the polished wooden bedside table in the dim glow of the lamp.
[L030 71.8-79.6] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Dowager Duchess looking intently at Juliana from her pillows, studying her bearing.
[L031 73.8-79.4] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Curious, Searching): "Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?"
[L032 79.6-86.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, her chin lifting with dignified sorrow and quiet defiance.
[L033 80.0-85.8] JULIANA (Painful, Proud): "Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor."
[L034 86.5-90.8] SCREEN: Medium tracking down Juliana's apron to her hand as she rests it against the bed linens, revealing a distinctive engraved signet ring on her finger.
[L035 87.0-90.5] ACTION: Juliana rests her right hand against the edge of the bedcover, unwittingly placing the unique ring directly within the Duchess's line of sight.
[L036 90.2-92.0] SFX: A sharp, stunned gasp.
[L037 90.8-95.0] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of the Dowager Duchess gasping sharply, her eyes widening in profound shock as all color drains from her face.
[L038 90.8-95.0] ACTION: The Duchess's mouth hangs open in pure disbelief as she stares fixedly at Juliana's hand.
[L039 95.0-100.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Duchess pushing herself up against the headboard, trembling as she stretches out her frail hand.
[L040 96.0-99.8] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Breathless, Shaken): "Your hand... Let me see your hand."
[L041 100.0-105.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana reacting with confusion and growing concern at the elder woman's sudden frenzy.
[L042 100.5-105.0] JULIANA (Confused, Alarmed): "Your Grace? What is wrong? You look as though you've seen a ghost."
[L043 105.5-109.0] SCREEN: Close-up shot of the Duchess's withered, shaking hand reaching across the blanket toward Juliana's arm.
[L044 106.0-109.0] ACTION: The Duchess reaches outward with trembling fingers, grasping frantically for Juliana.
[L045 108.8-110.0] SFX: A sudden sharp rustle of fabric as her fingers snap tight.
[L046 109.0-110.8] SCREEN: Tight shot of the Duchess's frail hand clamping down with fierce, unexpected strength onto Juliana's dark sleeve.
[L047 109.2-110.6] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Stern, Desperate): "Do not move!"
[L048 110.8-115.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess looking up at Juliana with overwhelming urgency and tears brimming in her wide eyes.
[L049 111.0-115.5] DOWAGER DUCHESS (Intense, Demanding): "Where... where... Where did you get this ring? Speak to me!"
[L050 115.8-119.5] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana frozen in shock, her breath catching as the Duchess's desperate words echo in the silence of the room.
[L051 119.5-120.9] SCREEN: Tight close-up of the Dowager Duchess's two weathered hands tightly clasping Juliana's hand, holding the signet ring between them as a dramatic orchestral cliffhanger chord swells, cutting sharply to black.

Task: find the best promo candidates in THIS episode. Return 1 to 3 candidates, best first. Fewer is fine when the episode has only one strong moment; never return two candidates that are nearly the same cut.

Return this JSON object:
{
  "episode_summary": "<= 45 words: what happens in this episode, with character names and roles, for story memory",
  "candidates": [
    {
      "title": "3-6 word editor label",
      "segments": [{"start_line": "L0xx", "end_line": "L0yy"}],
      "hook_line": "L0xx",
      "hook": "what the viewer sees/hears in the first 3 seconds and why it stops the scroll",
      "hook_quote": "exact words from hook_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "cliffhanger_line": "L0yy",
      "cliffhanger": "the unresolved question the viewer is left with at the cut",
      "cliffhanger_quote": "exact words from cliffhanger_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "why_it_works": "one sentence",
      "setup_needed": "what a brand-new viewer must already know to follow it, or \"none\"",
      "spoiler_risk": "low | medium | high (does it give away a major twist of the series?)",
      "self_score": 1-10
    }
  ]
}

YOUR PREVIOUS ANSWER:
{"candidates": [{"title": "The Duchess Recognizes Her", "segments": [{"start_line": "L048", "end_line": "L051"}], "hook_line": "L048", "hook": "The Dowager Duchess grabs Juliana with desperate, trembling hands, immediately creating a high-stakes mystery about their connection.", "hook_quote": "Do not move!", "cliffhanger_line": "L051", "cliffhanger": "The Duchess clutches Juliana's hand, holding the signet ring between them as the music swells, leaving the viewer wondering how the Duchess knows the ring.", "cliffhanger_quote": "", "why_it_works": "It starts on an intense physical confrontation and ends on a massive, unresolved mystery regarding the protagonist's secret identity.", "setup_needed": "none", "spoiler_risk": "low", "self_score": 10}]}

Some of your candidates broke the hard rules. Code computed these problems:
- "The Duchess Recognizes Her": total duration 10.1 s is outside 20-60 s; hook_quote is not an exact quote of L048 ('Close-up of the Dowager Duchess looking up at Juliana with overwhelming urgency ')

Return the same JSON shape again with corrected versions of ONLY the rejected candidates (same titles). Fix the boundaries by choosing different line IDs; keep the idea if it is good. Remember: 20-60 s total, hook_line starts within the first 3 s, cliffhanger_line inside the promo near its end, quotes copied exactly. Set episode_summary to "".
